messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] apac-prod keystore-decrypt-latency spike. >2s (threshold 0.2s). Affects warm-pool provisioning and node boot.

eva: seeing provisioning failures in apac: nodes stuck in 'initializing', kubelet logs show keystore decrypt timeouts. warm pool not filling.

sam: confirmed — autoscaler attempted to launch 18 nodes, 12 failed during startup with: `keystore decrypt timeout after 10s` and then moved to fallback on-demand hosts.

liam: putting numbers here — since 09:10Z: warm-pool fill rate down ~85%, provisioning latency +75%, on-demand fallback increased cost ~32% last 45m.

maria: any recent firewall or VPC egress changes in apac? Audit log shows a commit by infra/bastion-team at 08:58Z that tightened egress rules to a limited NAT range.

eva: that matches timeline. keystore (KMS proxy) talks to keystore-svc over privatelink -> then to kms. If NAT or proxy saturation happens decrypt calls hang.

sam: quick check of keystore proxy logs:
```
2026-03-19T09:12:43Z ERROR decrypt failed: upstream timeout (conn reuse: 18/50), ctx=bootstrap
2026-03-19T09:12:44Z WARN queue length=312, avg_decrypt_ms=2100
2026-03-19T09:13:01Z ERROR keystore: ssl handshake reset by peer
```

liam: also seeing conntrack near limit on the NAT gateway (conntrack_established ~ 92%). Cloud metrics show NAT burst throttle events starting 09:11Z.

maria: related: audit-log shipper backed up because of high write QPS — auditord has been retrying. Disk I/O on logging instance hit 98%. Could be compounding: logging / keystore traffic both hit NAT.

eva: TL;DR: firewall tightening + audit shipping spike -> NAT conntrack + IO saturation -> keystore decrypts time out -> nodes fail to finish bootstrap -> warm pool doesn't fill -> cost/latency cascade.

sam: mitigation options: 1) rollback the egress restriction in apac to previous CIDR (fast). 2) add dedicated privatelink endpoint for KMS/keystore traffic (medium). 3) increase NAT capacity (larger nat/gw or additional ENIs) + bump conntrack (short-term). 4) temporarily throttle audit log flush / buffer to S3 (short-term relief, needs approvals).

liam: I've started a roll-forward to restore previous egress policy as emergency rollback (PR #infra/egress/429). Waiting on 2 approvals from sec-sig. If no objection, I'll merge in 5m.

maria: sec-sig — rollback will reduce egress hardening. We should tag it as emergency; audit retention won't change, just path. I'll ping compliance and get explicit ack.

sam: parallel: I'll spin up a small privatelink (keystore-apac-ep) and wire keystore to it in staging, then can cut prod if rollback doesn't stabilize. ETA 40m for proof-of-concept.

eva: immediate quick fixes while we wait on approvals: - disable expensive audit shipper batching to reduce I/O (devex-bot can patch) - increase NAT target capacity (liam), add 1 additional NAT instance (warm/warm).

devex-bot: suggested command to toggle audit shipper buffer: `kubectl -n infra patch deploy audit-shipper -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"shipper","env":[{"name":"SHIPPER_MAX_BATCH","value":"200"}]}]}}}}'`

maria: patch approved OOO for immediate mitigation. devex-bot will apply in 2m and monitor.

liam: provisioning a new NAT gw now (request sent). If conntrack persists after NAT add, we'll need to increase node conntrack sysctl on keystore-proxy.

sam: cost note: if we run on-demand fallback for >2h, estimated incremental cost ~ $4.2k. Flagging for finance.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-APAC-KEYSTORE-01. Severity: high. Pager rotations notified.

eva: quick verification checklist after rollback/mitigations: 1) keystore avg_decrypt_ms < 200ms 2) warm-pool fill rate > 90% 3) no NAT throttle events for 15m 4) no audit shipper OOMs.

liam: update — egress rollback merged at 09:32Z. Nat gw added at 09:37Z. Audit shipper throttled at 09:34Z.

sam: monitoring shows avg_decrypt_ms dropping to ~180ms by 09:45Z, queue length down to 18. warm-pool starts filling again.

maria: compliance ok with emergency rollback with condition: open follow-up RFC to add dedicated privatelink for keystore + increase audit shipper resiliency.

eva: assigning action items: liam -> size NAT capacity permanently + conntrack tuning (owner), sam -> privatelink RFC + canary cutover (owner), maria -> compliance ticket + sign-off for privatelink, devex-bot -> revert audit shipper throttle after stabilization with controlled rollout.

sam: I'll start the RFC now (link: https://r.redwood/rfc/privatelink-keystore-apac).

liam: will open infra PR to raise conntrack and propose autoprop of NAT (PR #infra/nat/430). ETA EOD.

maria: finance notified of cost impact, they'll follow up on billing anomaly.

eva: closing the thread for now. Ping here if anything flares back up. :thumbsup:
